name: Ring Governance
description: Governance boundary patterns for no self-grading, evaluator immutability, evolution adapter review, and memory-is-not-proof discipline.
author: ChronodeAi

governanceFoundation.role: Portable governance principles; addon skills operate on the caller's current live workspace or explicitly supplied corpus.
principles: An untrusted producer may propose work but must not judge, promote, or edit the evaluator.
Fortemi and semantic memory provide context and provenance, never proof authority.
Evolution/search adapters such as evo-hq own proposal strategy while governance owns integrity gates.
